title: Embercrown is out: a 43 track NES style JRPG score on two pulses and a triangle
body:
Embercrown is a 43 track JRPG score written to the NES sound chip's pitched budget: two pulse channels and a triangle, and never more than three notes sounding at once. It is live now at $12.99, with 2 full tracks free to download from the page.

The constraint. The 2A03 triangle has no volume control. It is on at one level or it is off, which is why it plays the bass on every NES score anyone remembers and why that bass never ducks under a melody. So every bass note in this pack is the same instrument at the same velocity, all 43 tracks, and everything the bass appears to do dynamically is done with register and rhythm instead. Open any .mid and look at the bass track if you want to check that.

What is in it. Four towns and a night theme, five field and overworld cues, forest, two caves, a marsh, three dungeons, a ruin, a crypt, a court, a great hall, inn, shop, smithy, chantry, sea, open water, three grades of battle, two bosses, a final, a sorrow cue, an ending and eight stingers. 5 cells from one seed, stated 640 times across the album. 35 tracks loop on sample accurate LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags that RPG Maker reads directly, and the editable .mid ships beside every .ogg.

How it was checked. 766 theory checks and 492 audio checks, 0 failed, with both reports inside the download, plus a check written for this pack's own claim that reads the shipped MIDI and confirms one bass program and one bass velocity on 43 of 43 tracks. Those numbers say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the free tracks (Embercrown and The Embercrown Undone) are for.

The renders are a General MIDI reference render through a conventional soundfont, not chip emulation, and the Readme says so. The noise and DPCM channels are deliberately empty so your own sound effects are not fighting the music for them. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used.

https://csaf.itch.io/embercrown
